headline: Air quality crisis: Dhaka ranks 4th most polluted city globally
summary: The capital city has climbed the global rankings of the most polluted cities, posing significant health risks to millions of residents.
details: Dhaka has been ranked as the 4th most polluted city in the world, highlighting a severe air quality crisis in the capital.
The ranking reflects the high levels of atmospheric pollutants that residents breathe daily, affecting public health across the city.
Air pollution in Dhaka is often driven by construction dust, vehicle emissions, and industrial pollutants.
Health experts warn that prolonged exposure to such poor air quality can lead to severe respiratory issues and other long-term health complications.
caption:
Dhaka is now the 4th most polluted city in the world. The air we breathe is becoming a critical health hazard.
